other_conditions: Unemployed youth who have passed the Intermediate examination (10+2)
Applicants must not be receiving benefits of any other government‑run scheme such as scholarship or fee reimbursement
Trainees are eligible for the scheme only once for ‘O’ Level/‘CCC’ training
A trainee may enroll for ‘O’ Level in the next financial year only after completing ‘CCC’
75% biometric attendance is compulsory during the training session
If a trainee is absent for more than 15 days without a valid reason, they will be replaced from the waiting list
benefits_summary: Free computer training (‘O’ Level or ‘CCC’) with training fees covered up to Rs. 15,000 for the ‘O’ level and Rs. 3,500 for the ‘CCC’ level per trainee.
